Sofia, I posted the bullets in #coastal-team, but I made a mistake with the draft. I saved it in my own mailbox (assistant@pemberline.com), not yours, so you can't open or send it. I've posted a correction in the thread. The draft is addressed to joseilark@pemberline.com and is signed "Sofia", which is wrong for a draft I wrote. Copy the bullets into a new mail from your own account if you want to send it to June.

The bullets come from a May 18 coverage note that Moss wrote to Ruth. Sofia can't see that note, so the label "Covey — Late Arrivals" may have changed since then. Check the saved report before you rely on it.
